summary: A quiet day for competitors: Lasso, URLgenius and Button/Posttap had nothing new.
Amazon's own posts were corporate news (water, data centres, engineering roles), with nothing on Associates, OneLink or the Influencer program.
Goodreads leaned into the 'A Court of Splintered Harmony' (ACOTAR 6) launch, the biggest book release of the week.
Reddit searches were rate-limited, so Reddit chatter about competitors wasn't checked today.

items.title: Goodreads Readers Are Excited About These 5 New Books Hitting Shelves—From ‘ACOTAR 6’ to Historical Fiction
items.why: Goodreads readers' most-wanted list is driving coverage of this week's new books, led by ACOTAR 6. A big launch week like this is when authors and readers click the most book links.
